sources.entry: EdgeEver - Open-source note-taking and knowledge workspace with self-hosting, multi-device sync, and MCP integration. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: EdgeEver
summary.one_liner: EdgeEver is an open-source, AI-native note-taking and knowledge workspace that can be self-hosted on Cloudflare or Docker and used across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android and a browser clipper.
use_cases: connect a local AI agent such as Claude Code or Codex to notes
clip web pages, images and tweets into a knowledge base
draw mind maps and flowcharts inside notes
format articles for WeChat official accounts
migrate and back up notes as Markdown with attachments
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a note app with a classic three-pane layout (notebook tree, note list, editor) and both rich-text and Markdown source views. Desktop uses a local SQLite mirror and connects to local agents (Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek) via ACP, and an AI companion sidebar offers selection-based explain, translate, proofread and polish. It includes a built-in Remote MCP so external assistants can read and write notes. Hosting options are Cloudflare Workers (stated to fit the free tier for personal use) or a Docker one-line script with local or S3-compatible storage. Export is standard SQLite plus a ZIP of Markdown, attachments and version history.
notable: Native ACP and Remote MCP integration with local AI agents
Self-hostable on Cloudflare free tier or Docker with S3-compatible storage
Built-in diagrams (mind maps, flowcharts) and WeChat article formatting
Standard SQLite storage with full Markdown ZIP export
caveats: iOS client must be downloaded from the App Store using a non-mainland-China Apple ID
Cloudflare free tier capacity is stated as roughly 150,000 notes and 50,000 images for personal use
Pricing of the hosted option beyond the free tier is not stated on the page
